page_title: NET 2-0 QAT | Netherlands v Qatar 29/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Meshaal Barsham, who smothers the ball.
90+2' OFF THE BAR! Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' Boualem Khoukhi (Qatar) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the top right corner, but Andries Noppert pulls off a decent save to deny him.
88' A thunderous effort from long range by Pedro Miguel (Qatar) goes well wide of the left post.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frenkie de Jong leaves the pitch and Kenneth Taylor (Netherlands) comes on.
85' Felix Sanchez Bas has decided to make a change. Musab Khoder (Qatar) replaces Ismaeel Mohammad.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abdulaziz Hatem departs the field of play to be replaced by Ahmed Alaaeldin (Qatar).
84' The attendance is 66784.
82' Substitution. Marten de Roon leaves the pitch and is replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands).
82' Louis van Gaal prepares a substitution. Cody Gakpo is replaced by Wout Weghorst (Netherlands).
82' The foul by Mohammed Muntari (Qatar) was seen by Bakary Gassama who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
80' Half-chance! Homam Ahmed (Qatar) plays a pass into the box, but Andries Noppert reacts well to snuff out the attack.
77' A pass finds the feet of Abdulaziz Hatem (Qatar) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
74' Netherlands take a short corner kick.
74' A pass from Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) is intercepted by Meshaal Barsham and the move breaks down. The ball goes out for a corner. Netherlands can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Netherlands work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
73' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Netherlands force a corner. They send men into the box.
70' The Netherlands players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Bakary Gassama signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to a handball.
69' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Netherlands players aren’t happy.
68' Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
66' Memphis Depay goes off the pitch and Vincent Janssen (Netherlands) comes on.
66' Louis van Gaal has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Steven Berghuis (Netherlands) replacing Davy Klaassen.
64' Substitution. Hasan Al Haydos will be replaced by Ali Assadalla (Qatar).
64' Felix Sanchez Bas has decided to substitute Almoez Ali and he is replaced by Mohammed Muntari (Qatar).
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Assim Omer Madibo as he is replaced by Karim Boudiaf (Qatar).
63' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andries Noppert intercepts the ball.
62' Daley Blind (Netherlands) brings an opponent down and Bakary Gassama interrupts the game.
60' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
59' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Davy Klaassen (Netherlands).
56' A pass by Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Netherlands will take a throw-in.
55' Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick has been awarded to Qatar.
52' Nathan Ake (Netherlands) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bakary Gassama had an easy-decision to make.
49' 2 - 0 Goal! Frenkie de Jong (Netherlands) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 2:0.
49' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) gets inside the box and tries to beat Meshaal Barsham with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
48' Ismaeel Mohammad (Qatar) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
47' Akram Afif (Qatar) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
46' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) is penalised for holding. Bakary Gassama signals a set piece. Qatar have a free kick from a promising distance.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Wasted effort! Memphis Depay (Netherlands) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Abdulaziz Hatem (Qatar) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Bakary Gassama stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Netherlands have a free kick.
41' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is flagged for offside.
40' Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) passes the ball onto Almoez Ali, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
39' Assim Omer Madibo (Qatar) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Netherlands.
36' Ismaeel Mohammad (Qatar) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Qatar will have a throw-in.
34' Marten de Roon (Netherlands) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Qatar have been awarded a free kick.

32' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bakary Gassama blows his whistle for an infringement. Qatar win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
31' Netherlands hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
29' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Ismaeel Mohammad (Qatar) causes Andries Noppert little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
26' 1 - 0 Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the right post.
26' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
25' Corner kick falls to Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar), who shows his quick reaction with a snap shot. The ball, however, goes well over the bar.
25' Akram Afif (Qatar) will take a corner kick.

24' Akram Afif (Qatar) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Qatar force their opponents to concede a corner.
24' The resulting corner from Akram Afif (Qatar) is cleared by the defence.
23' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Qatar will take a corner kick.
21' Bakary Gassama blows his whistle as Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
20' A pass by Akram Afif (Qatar) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
19' Davy Klaassen (Netherlands) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
19' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) will deliver the corner kick.

18' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Corner kick. Netherlands will have an opportunity.
17' The game is interrupted as Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is flagged offside.
16' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
16' Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Netherlands have been awarded a corner kick.
14' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Memphis Depay (Netherlands), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar.
14' Frenkie de Jong (Netherlands) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
13' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) commits a foul and Bakary Gassama immediately signals a free kick.
12' Daley Blind (Netherlands) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
10' Akram Afif (Qatar) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
9' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
8' Bakary Gassama blows his whistle and it's Davy Klaassen (Netherlands) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
7' Ismaeel Mohammad (Qatar) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
5' Ismaeel Mohammad (Qatar) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
4' Daley Blind (Netherlands) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, makes a stunning save.
3' Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Andries Noppert makes a comfortable save.
3' The linesman signals that Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

1' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Qatar will have a goal kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Netherlands will kick-off.
Bakary Gassama is introduced as the referee for today's match.
